name: Durian sugarcane juice
summary: Sugarcane juice with durian, along National Highway 22. Báo Quốc tế also says mung bean in place of durian. Tuổi Trẻ says one stall has sold the drink for more than 30 years and prints no street.
origin: Củ Chi, along National Highway 22 on the tourism center account and on the Báo Quốc tế account.
howToEat: Drink it. The tourism center prints no recipe. Báo Quốc tế says sugarcane with durian or with mung bean.
Tuổi Trẻ, on 5 May 2024, says a stall open more than 30 years sells nước mía sầu riêng, and prints no street.
No price was printed. Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: National Highway 22. The tourism center and Báo Quốc tế both place the drink there. Neither prints a marker.
Tuổi Trẻ prints no street for the stall.
seoTitle: Durian sugarcane juice in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Durian sugarcane juice along National Highway 22. Báo Quốc tế also says a mung-bean mix. The price is Check on arrival.
taste: Báo Quốc tế says cool sugarcane with the aroma of durian, or of mung bean. The tourism center says aromatic and does not give a recipe.
